stanza: *Phone rings*
“Hello?”
“Yes, a collect call for Mrs. Floyd from Mr. Floyd. Will you accept the charge,…
*Phone clicks*
“Oh, he hung up. That's your residence? Well, I wonder why he hung up. Is there…
*Phone redials and beeps again*
“Hello?”
“This is the United States calling. Are we reaching…”
*Phone clicks*
“See, he keeps hanging up, and it's a man answering.”
*Dial tone*
